findings.title: Missing H1 Tag
findings.evidence: No <h1> tag found in the HTML. (affects 3 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Include exactly one <h1> tag summarizing the page topic.

findings.title: Thin Content
findings.evidence: Word count is 227. (affects 6 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Expand the page content to provide more value (aim for >300 words).

findings.title: Missing Image Alt Text
findings.evidence: 2 out of 25 images lack an alt attribute. (affects 2 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text to all images for screen readers.

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tag
findings.evidence: No <link rel="canonical"> tag found.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referencing canonical tag to prevent duplicate content issues.

findings.title: Missing XML Sitemap
findings.evidence: No sitemap URLs found in site data.

suggested_action.summary: Provide an XML sitemap and reference it in robots.txt.

findings.title: Duplicate Title Tags
findings.evidence: Title 'Coding Practice Problems & Tutorials | TutorialsPoint' is shared across 2 pages. (affects 2 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Ensure every page has a unique title tag.

findings.title: Missing Hreflang Tags
findings.evidence: 9 pages lack hreflang tags on a multi-language site. (affects 9 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Ensure hreflang tags are implemented consistently across all localized pages.

findings.title: Suboptimal Title Length
findings.evidence: Title length is 26 characters. (affects 4 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Keep title tags between 30 and 60 characters.

findings.title: Suboptimal Meta Description Length
findings.evidence: Description length is 235 characters. (affects 5 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Keep meta descriptions between 70 and 155 characters.

findings.title: Missing JSON-LD
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD script tags found. (affects 7 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Implement JSON-LD structured data to enhance rich snippets.

findings.title: Images Missing Lazy Loading
findings.evidence: 14 images lack loading="lazy". (affects 6 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.evidence: Missing headers: x-frame-options (affects 10 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Implement standard security headers to protect users.

findings.title: Canonical Points to Different URL
findings.evidence: Canonical href (https://www.tutorialspoint.com) differs from page URL (https://www.tutorialspoint.com/). (affects 2 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Verify that the canonical URL is the intended master version.

findings.title: Skipped Heading Levels
findings.evidence: Heading skipped from H2 to H4. (affects 7 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Ensure heading levels are nested properly without skipping levels.

findings.title: Excessive DOM Size
findings.evidence: Found 2116 HTML elements. (affects 2 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Reduce DOM complexity to improve rendering performance.

findings.title: Missing Open Graph Tags
findings.evidence: Missing tags: og:title, og:image (affects 4 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Add missing Open Graph meta tags for better social sharing.

findings.title: Missing HTML Lang Attribute
findings.evidence: The <html> tag has no 'lang' attribute.

suggested_action.summary: Specify the primary language of the page in the <html> tag.

findings.title: Missing x-default Hreflang
findings.evidence: Hreflang tags exist but none is 'x-default'.

suggested_action.summary: Add an x-default hreflang tag for unmatched languages/regions.

findings.title: Duplicate Meta Descriptions
findings.evidence: Meta description is shared across 2 pages. (affects 2 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Ensure every page has a unique meta description.

findings.title: Suboptimal URL Structure
findings.evidence: Contains underscores (affects 4 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Use short, lowercase URLs with hyphens instead of underscores.

findings.title: Missing Twitter Card
findings.evidence: No twitter:card meta tag found. (affects 7 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Add a twitter:card meta tag to optimize sharing on Twitter.

findings.title: Unsafe target="_blank" Links
findings.evidence: Found 14 links missing rel="noopener" or rel="noreferrer". (affects 8 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Add rel="noopener" to external links that open in a new tab.

findings.title: Low Text-to-HTML Ratio
findings.evidence: Ratio is 0.76% (<10%). (affects 7 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Increase readable text or reduce HTML bloat.

findings.title: Missing Form Labels
findings.evidence: Found 2 form inputs without associated labels. (affects 8 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Ensure all form controls have an associated <label>.

findings.title: Missing ARIA Landmarks
findings.evidence: No semantic HTML5 landmarks or ARIA landmark roles found. (affects 2 pages)

suggested_action.summary: Use semantic HTML5 elements or ARIA roles to define page regions.

findings.title: Multiple H1 Tags
findings.evidence: Found 2 <h1> tags.

suggested_action.summary: Use only one <h1> tag per page for best SEO practices.

findings.title: Non-Descriptive Anchor Text
findings.evidence: Found 10 links with generic anchor text.

suggested_action.summary: Use descriptive keywords in anchor text.
